page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-2x.8xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for workloads requiring dedicated parallel processing capabilities. Running on the KVM hypervisor, this instance features 32 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8369B processors operating at a base frequency of 2.9 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

The primary hardware highlight of the ecs.gn7i-2x.8xlarge is its dual NVIDIA A10 GPU configuration, delivering a combined 48 GB of VRAM. This hardware profile is engineered to accelerate graphics rendering, deep learning inference, and high-performance computing tasks. The instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps, facilitating data transfer between the instance and external storage or services.

Given the dual NVIDIA A10 GPUs and dedicated Intel Xeon processors, this instance is optimized for workloads such as AI inference, video transcoding, 3D rendering, and moderately intensive deep learning training. The absence of local storage represents a design tradeoff, requiring users to provision and manage external cloud storage volumes to handle data persistence.
